issues.description: The type of the Person.birthday attribute is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and the template model declare birthday as java.time.LocalDate, while the solution's common Person model uses a String for birthday. Additionally, client UI code (PersonScene) expects a LocalDate from Person.getBirthday(), creating a structural mismatch that will cause compilation errors or runtime type issues and will confuse students about the expected type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person.birthday type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably restore java.time.LocalDate in the solution's common Person model (and remove any stray unused imports), and ensure server and client code use LocalDate (Jackson will handle ISO date mapping by default with proper configuration). Alternatively, if String is intended, update the problem statement, template model, and UI code to use String consistently and document the format expected. Ensure all usages and comparisons in PersonService and PersonScene are updated to match the chosen type.
